hypotheses.R1_dose_response: Median target-feature transfer increases at every tested top-mode dose.
hypotheses.R2_spectral_specificity: At 10% norm, top-mode feature transfer exceeds both matched low-mode and wrong-category transfer by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.R3_full_sae_coverage: The complete changed Top-128 SAE code reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.R4_adaptive_compactness: An adaptive 32-feature ensemble reaches at least 80% of full-code downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.R5_fixed_core_transfer: The frozen category-specific 32-feature core retains at least 75% of adaptive-32 downstream fidelity.
